summary.text: Hershey is a Chicago teacher and the Working Class Party nominee for the open 4th District seat. He has taught at Lindblom Math and Science Academy in West Englewood, served as a union representative, and ran for 25th Ward alderman in 2015 and for this congressional seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Born in Rochester, New York; earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Chicago in 2001.
Works as a teacher at Lindblom Math and Science Academy in West Englewood on Chicago's South Side, and has served as a union representative.
In his 2024 Ballotpedia survey, says he became more involved in the teachers union at his school in the run-up to the 2012 teachers' strike.
Ran for Chicago City Council in the 25th Ward in 2015, finishing fifth with 8.2% of the vote (614 votes).
Ran as the Working Class Party candidate for Illinois' 4th District in 2022 (3.5%) and 2024 (5.2%).
Was unopposed in the March 17, 2026 Working Class Party primary for the open seat.
